log_matches_trail.description: one log line per ticket, pointing at its trail root

stages_complete.description: every stage the ticket's path requires is in its trail

model_calls_complete.description: every model call records model, tokens and cost

posts_traced.description: every posted decision has its helpdesk call and attempts

cost_reconciles.description: trail model costs equal the cost in the log line

failures_explained.description: every failure or non-success outcome carries a cause

tree_intact.description: no orphan spans; children share ticket and fit in parent's time

no_leaks.description: no text fields in the log; no payment details in log or trail
